Billing guide
## Refund policy Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. After 14 days, annual plans are not refundable, but you can cancel auto-renewal at any time and keep access until the end of the term. Monthly plans are not refundable; cancelling stops the next charge. Refunds are issued to the original payment method and typically

cancelling stops the next charge. Refunds are issued to the original payment method and typically arrive within 5 business days, though some banks take up to 10. The billing date cannot currently be moved; if you need invoices aligned to a fiscal month, switch to annual billing and choose the start date

invoices aligned to a fiscal month, switch to annual billing and choose the start date when you upgrade. Invoices are emailed to the billing contact and are available under Settings > Billing > Invoices for seven years. VAT is applied based on the billing address; add a VAT number to receive reverse-charge invoices in the EU. ## Seats and user

add a VAT number to receive reverse-charge invoices in the EU. ## Seats and user management You are billed for seats, not for people: a seat is a licence that can be assigned to a user and reassigned when someone leaves. Removing a user frees the seat immediately; the seat count only changes when an admin reduces it under Settings

If you believe you were charged for more seats than you assigned, check the seat count on the plan page first - unassigned seats are still billed. ##

Pro includes unlimited seats at a per-seat price, 250,000 API calls per month, SSO, audit logs and email support with a one-business-day response target. Enterprise adds a custom API

audit logs and email support with a one-business-day response target. Enterprise adds a custom API quota, dedicated support with a four-hour response target, data residency options and a signed DPA. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated; downgrades apply at the next renewal.

Security and access guide
## Setting up SSO SSO is available on Pro and Enterprise. We support SAML 2.0 and OIDC. An admin configures it under Settings > Security > SSO by entering the identity provider's metadata URL or certificate, then testing with a single user before enforcing it for the organisation. Once enforced, password logins are disabled for everyone except break-glass admin accounts,

Security and access guide
for the organisation. Once enforced, password logins are disabled for everyone except break-glass admin accounts, which we recommend keeping to two. SCIM provisioning is available on Enterprise to create and deactivate users automatically. ## Reporting a security issue If you believe you have found a vulnerability or that your account has been compromised, email security@ (or use the in-app 'Report

vulnerability or that your account has been compromised, email security@ (or use the in-app 'Report a security issue' link) rather than opening a normal ticket. Include what you observed, the time, and any request IDs. We acknowledge reports within 24 hours and do not take action against good-faith researchers. For a suspected account compromise, also rotate your API keys immediately

action against good-faith researchers. For a suspected account compromise, also rotate your API keys immediately from Settings > API keys and enable SSO enforcement if available. ## Password resets and locked accounts Use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page; the reset link is valid for 30 minutes and can only be used once. Accounts lock for 15 minutes after ten

Security and access guide
30 minutes and can only be used once. Accounts lock for 15 minutes after ten failed attempts. If your organisation enforces SSO, password reset is disabled and you must reset through your identity provider. Admins can also send a reset link from the user's page. We never ask for passwords by email or chat. ## API rate limits Each API

We never ask for passwords by email or chat. ## API rate limits Each API key is limited to 60 requests per minute on Starter, 600 on Pro and a negotiated limit on Enterprise. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header; clients should back off exponentially and honour the header. Monthly call quotas are separate from per-minute

should back off exponentially and honour the header. Monthly call quotas are separate from per-minute limits and are shown on the usage page; when a quota is exhausted, requests return 402 until the next cycle or until the plan is upgraded. Webhook deliveries do not count toward the quota.

Data and support guide
## Data retention and deletion Customer data is retained for the life of the subscription and for 30 days after cancellation, during which you can export it or reactivate. After 30 days the workspace and its backups are scheduled for deletion, completed within a further 30 days. Audit logs are retained for 1 year on Pro and 3 years on

Data and support guide
30 days. Audit logs are retained for 1 year on Pro and 3 years on Enterprise. To delete a workspace sooner, an owner can request immediate deletion from Settings > Workspace; this is irreversible and requires typing the workspace name to confirm. ## Exporting your data Owners and admins can export all workspace data as a ZIP of CSV and

data Owners and admins can export all workspace data as a ZIP of CSV and JSON files from Settings > Workspace > Export. Exports are generated asynchronously; you receive an email with a download link that expires after 72 hours. Large workspaces can take several hours. Email support (Pro) is staffed Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 18:00 UTC, with a one-business-day first-response target. Enterprise support is 24/7
